messages:
alex_k: Quick idea — surface 'throttle hints' in the Console and as optional API headers so clients can gracefully fallback. e.g. show remaining burst tokens and next refill time.

maria_t: +1. Would help SDKs decide to switch to cached responses or reduce chunking.

samir_p: Important: need to ensure showing this doesn’t leak org-level capacity to end users for multi-tenant setups. privacy/abuse risk.

jenna_ui: Prototype thought: a small pill next to quota usage -> "burst: 30 (refill in 35s)". Click expands to explain what burst means and a sample header. Low noise.

kevin_sre: From infra side we can emit hints, but need to define canonical semantics first: per-key tokens vs per-org pool vs reserved Dedicated capacity. Also TTL semantics for the refill timestamp.

quota-bot: auto-report: current behavior (prod):
```
X-Quota-Plan: pro
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 120
X-Burst-Tokens: 30
X-Burst-Refill-At: 1961234605
```
This is approximate; header names and presence depend on routing policy.

alex_k: Nice. Two UX questions: (1) should Console surface plan-specific guidance (e.g. "upgrade to Dedicated for sustained throughput")? (2) do we show predicted cost impact if they exceed softburst?

maria_t: For (1) yes but soft — only show upgrade prompts if usage pattern indicates repeated throttles. For (2) we can show a simple estimate: "exceeding burst 10x/day ≈ ~$0.XX/day" (privacy-safe aggregate).

samir_p: Edgecase: shared API keys (internal platform teams). We need an override to hide per-key tokens and show only org pool in Console. Also enforcement logic must be consistent: if org pool depletes, per-key headers should indicate fallback to org-limit.

kevin_sre: Implementation note: telemetry must correlate three metrics: token-usage, throttle-events, and refill-schedule. We should record measurements at request acceptance time and on reject so we can backfill and alert. Tag telemetry with: `plan`, `deployment-mode` (hosted/dedicated/private), `route` and `scope` (key/org).

jenna_ui: For the Console visual: small sparkline for burst consumption + hover shows last 1h throttle events. Also add a minimal explainer modal for devs. Mock attached (will upload after this thread).

maria_t: Telemetry + Console -> product wants a per-plan dashboard showing typical burst windows, a list of keys that frequently hit soft-throttle, and an export for billing ops. Need to confirm PII constraints.

alex_k: Sounds like next steps: (a) define header schema + semantics (kevin), (b) add telemetry events & tags (kevin + samir), (c) Console mock + wording (jenna + maria), (d) backlog ticket to gate upgrade nudges (product). I'll own coordinating.

kevin_sre: I'll draft header RFC this week. Also note: Dedicated customers may opt out of emitting per-key token counts in headers for security — we should support a toggle.

samir_p: I'll add the telemetry schema and a short privacy checklist.

jenna_ui: Will push mock screenshots to #design after lunch.

alex_k: Great — assigning: @kevin_sre (header RFC), @samir_p (telemetry + privacy checklist), @jenna_ui (Console mocks). Thanks all :thumbsup:
